team.name: Myka Ella A. Dalit
team.bio: Serves as Assistant Project Lead, overseeing 3D CAD modeling, mechanical design, and Nextion HMI interface development. Manages budget allocation, procurement, manuscript writing, technical editing, and proofreading to ensure seamless project integration and delivery.

team.name: Alleny P. Hernandez
team.bio: Oversees project coordination, manuscript preparation, budget, quality assurance, and documentation. Also handles research adviser communications, data gathering, and project testing to ensure the project's progress and successful completion.

team.name: Mark James L. Alcantara
team.bio: Leads the project from design to deployment, integrating the hardware, firmware, mobile application, and cloud services into one working system. Develops the Arduino and ESP32 firmware and the mobile app, and coordinates testing to keep the device reliable.

team.name: John Rei R. Tolentino
team.bio: Manages communications with research advisers, oversees data collection, and conducts project testing to ensure smooth execution and successful project completion.

team.name: Arwin E. Eser Jose
team.bio: Leads subsystem integration and interface validation across the hardware, firmware, display, communication, and cloud layers to deliver a stable end-to-end system. Contributes to hardware development and sensor calibration, runs benchtop and field test procedures, and analyzes deployment data to verify dispensing accuracy and system reliability.

team.name: Brylle Edward A. Ramos
team.bio: Assisting device control, quality assurance, and documentation. Handles device wiring and components functionality for the project's successful execution.
